Subject: BrightLane Dedicated Renewal: q3-q4 throughput & GPU recs

Hi Elena — attaching the capacity forecast for the renewal conversation next month. High-level summary up front:

- Current reserved pool: 4x A100-equivalent GPUs (production) serving ~120 QPS peak with ~6k tokens/sec aggregate.
- Observed growth: steady ~15–20% m/m in QPS across the last 3 months; token averages per request up ~8%.
- Forecast (conservative): +40% aggregate QPS by start of Q3 (renewal window), peak QPS ~168.
- Recommendation: reserve 6 GPUs for initial term (Q3 start) with an option to expand to 8 GPUs at month 3 if monthly peak >150 QPS for two consecutive weeks. This balances cost vs headroom while giving a contractual expansion path.

Technical notes: model variant is GLM-2-13B-8q (production quantized). With 6 GPUs we can sustain target peak with 95th-tail latency objective ~220ms with continuous batching and prefix caching; 8 GPUs reduces 95th to ~140–160ms and provides redundancy for rolling upgrades.

Attachments: BrightLane_2026_q3-q4_forecast.xlsx (xlsx - 74KB)

I put the forecast and GPU sizing logic in the sheet (traffic curves, batch sizing assumptions, cold-start/redistribution impact). Happy to walk through numbers.

Thanks,
Marcus Lin
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: BrightLane Dedicated Renewal: q3-q4 throughput & GPU recs

Elena — thanks for the quick review. Short answers here and we can schedule a 30min call if helpful.

1) Ballpark pricing: 6x reserved GPUs (monthly committed) vs 8x is roughly a 30–33% increase in recurring compute fee. I'll attach a draft term sheet with tiered pricing and an explicit expansion clause (we can structure as an add-on at a fixed monthly rate or a short mid-term true-up).
2) Phased commitment: yes — we can do an initial 6x commit with a contractual option to add 1–2 GPUs at a pre-agreed monthly rate after a 90-day evaluation trigger. The add option can be exercised by a signed amendment or automatic if telemetry crosses the agreed threshold.
3) SLA: adding GPUs does not loosen SLA; expansions are covered by the same uptime and latency SLOs once capacity is provisioned. We will include an ingress window (72 hours typical for capacity provisioning) in the term language.

I’ve attached a draft term sheet (v2) for internal numbers; Rafael and Rishi, please confirm margin impact and final pricing ranges so I can share a clean version with BrightLane.

Attachments: renewal_term_sheet_v2.pdf (pdf - 48KB)

Thanks,

Date: Thu, 13 May 2026 15:30:00 -0700
Subject: RE: BrightLane Dedicated Renewal: q3-q4 throughput & GPU recs

Ava — quick internal note on pricing and risk:

- Margin: 6 GPUs at the standard reserved rate gives us ~42% gross margin; 8 GPUs at list would push to ~46% but increases committed exposure.
- Recommend offering a phased economic structure:
  * Option A (Conservative): Commit to 6 GPUs for 12 months at 10% discount; 2 GPU expansion right at month 3 for an additional fixed monthly fee (no rollback).
  * Option B (Aggressive): Commit to 8 GPUs for 12 months at 18% discount with a 60-day performance review and a partial rebate if utilization <75% at month 3.
- We should also include an early expansion addendum: fixed-price add of 1 GPU (pro-rated month-of) with a 72-hour provisioning SLA; more than 1 GPU requires 10 business days lead. That keeps operational cadence predictable.

Rishi — can you confirm whether finance approves the Option A discounted tier with the expansion addendum? If yes, we can present Option A as our recommended/low-risk path.

Rafael
Account Director, Redwood Inference
rafael_mendes@redwood.com

- Start: 6x GPUs reserved at the agreed monthly fee starting 1 July 2026.
- Expansion option: +1 GPU after 45 days if weekly peak >140 QPS for two consecutive weeks; +1 additional GPU only after month 3 with a signed amendment (so max to 8 GPUs).
- We need a firm 72-hour provisioning SLA for single-GPU adds and a 10-business-day window for >1 GPU.
- Please confirm the add-on pricing and provide a single-line summary of the monthly delta for our procurement review.

Procurement contact (procure@brightlane.io) is handling the paperwork; they will expect a final term sheet + DocuSign.

Elena
